title: Strengthening Your Relationship with God (Listening to God)
description: A lesson on how believers can listen to God through His Word and grow in sensitivity to His voice.

cards.heading: Sharing Your Week
cards.scriptureText: Come and hear, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.
cards.body: Take time to share what happened during the past week. Be sensitive to the needs and struggles of one another as you listen and encourage each other.
cards.question: What is something meaningful that happened to you this week?

cards.heading: Reviewing God’s Word
cards.scriptureText: Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.
cards.body: Review previously learned verses together. God’s Word strengthens your foundation and helps you grow in your relationship with Him.
cards.question: How have these verses helped you in your daily life?

cards.heading: God Speaks Through the Bible
cards.scriptureText: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness.
cards.body: God primarily speaks through His Word. Setting aside a specific time and place to read the Bible helps you hear Him clearly and consistently.
cards.question: Do you have a regular time and place to read the Bible?

cards.heading: Growing Through Daily Reading
cards.scriptureText: Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night.
cards.body: Regular reading of Scripture helps you understand God’s will. Reflect on what you read and allow it to guide your thoughts and actions.
cards.question: What have you learned from your Bible reading recently?

cards.heading: God Speaks to Your Heart
cards.scriptureText: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
cards.body: God also speaks to your heart. As you grow in your relationship with Him, you will become more sensitive to His guidance and direction.
cards.question: Have you experienced God speaking to your heart? What was it like?

cards.heading: Learning to Listen
cards.scriptureText: Be still, and know that I am God.
cards.body: Listening to God requires stillness and focus. Spend quiet time with Him, removing distractions, and allow Him to speak to your heart.
cards.question: What makes it difficult for you to be still and listen to God?

cards.heading: Sharing What You Hear
cards.body: After spending time with God, share what you have learned or felt with one another. This builds encouragement and strengthens faith.
cards.question: What is something you feel God is teaching you right now?

cards.heading: Prayer and Sensitivity to God
cards.scriptureText: Call to me and I will answer you.
cards.body: Prayer is not only speaking to God but also listening. Thank Him for the privilege of hearing His voice and ask Him to help you become more sensitive to Him.
cards.question: How can you grow in listening to God during prayer?

cards.heading: Next Steps
cards.scriptureText: Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.
cards.body: Set your next meeting and continue practicing daily time with God. Read and memorize the assigned verse as part of your growth.
cards.question: What step will you take this week to listen to God more clearly?
